plugins.name: quest-tracker
plugins.description: An always-visible tracker of what you are actually doing: the main quest and its numbered steps, the tangents that do not block it, and the background work running without you, in a tmux pane. Includes phone mode: when you are driving the session remotely and cannot see the pane, the tracker rides in the replies instead.

plugins.name: tldr
plugins.description: Blocks a long reply from ending without a TL;DR at the bottom.

plugins.name: preview-link
plugins.description: Ends every reply with the deploy preview for the branch's open PR. On a phone that link is otherwise several taps and a scroll away, buried in a bot comment on the pull request.
